buildType: deterministic fixed-anchor augmentation of the exact device-verified Next Hour Provider Conversion bundles; not Rollup

feature.matchDiagnostics: Per-Apple-event region/type/severity/exact-time/candidate counts; no event values
feature.genericWarningSuffixNormalization: Strip only a terminal generic warning marker in the type key; severity and exact issue time remain mandatory

validation.bundleSyntax: node --check passed for request and response scripts

limitations: The alert implementation has no exported user Apple binary fixture; the WK3 b66 layout is taken from upstream v3.3.6's paired-sample documentation and synthetic FlatBuffer tests.
QWeather Web page DOM/availability may change; an unmatched or failed source keeps Apple's original alert URLs.
Synthetic response replay is not iPhone UI acceptance; the alert page still requires manual iOS 27.3/Surge verification.
Full Rollup build is unavailable because private @nsringo/weatherkit previously returned HTTP 401; bundle generation uses hash-pinned fixed-anchor augmentation.
The Fangshan phone log supplied so far has aggregate event_unmatched only; no raw Apple binary or QWeather source page was supplied, so per-event real matching cause and alert UI remain unverified.
